title: Unlocking the Secrets of Longevity: A Conversation with Dr. Mona Garha
excerpt: Delve into the importance of bioidentical hormones in modern medicine and learn how these plant-based treatments can improve mental health, balance hormones, and enhance overall well-being. Dr. Mona Garha shares her innovative practices in primary care, focusing on young adults' health and longevity.
